description: This file is the main entry point for a React-based frontend application. It initializes the React app by rendering the root component into the DOM, specifically into the element with the id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, the main App component, and styles.css.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree, targeting the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot().render
methods.description: Rhythms the rendering of the React component into the DOM, wrapping it in React.StrictMode for enabling additional checks and warnings.
